records.source: To Mr. Pierre:^It pains me to be the bearer of bad news, but I feel obligated to inform you of a recent development most threatening to your livelihood.^Joja Co. has decided to expand into Pelican Town.^It's too late for protest. Joja Builders have already broken ground for the new JojaMart.^^This must be devastating news for you. So many years in business...a local standby... and now, obscured by the shadow of a powerful, efficient, economically viable corporation. What a shame!^^As manager of the new JojaMart, I feel, to some degree, personally responsible for your predicament. As such, I'd like to offer you a position as Assistant Grocer. Wages start at 5g an hour. I look forward to seeing your resume!^^-Mr. Morris, Manager^Pelican Town JojaMart
records.translation: Para kay G. Pierre:^Ikinalulungkot kong ako ang maghatid ng masamang balita, ngunit tungkulin kong ipaalam sa iyo ang isang bagong pangyayaring lubhang nagbabanta sa iyong kabuhayan.^Nagpasya ang Joja Co. na magpalawak sa Bayan ng Pelican.^Huli na para tumutol. Sinimulan na ng mga Tagapagtayo ng Joja ang pagtatayo ng bagong JojaMart.^^Tiyak na napakasakit ng balitang ito para sa iyo. Napakaraming taon sa negosyo...matagal nang sandigan ng komunidad... at ngayon ay natatakpan ng anino ng isang makapangyarihan, mahusay, at matatag sa pananalaping korporasyon. Kay sayang!^^Bilang tagapamahala ng bagong JojaMart, sa isang banda ay personal akong nananagot sa kalagayan mo. Kaya nais kong alukin ka ng posisyon bilang Katulong na Tindero. Nagsisimula ang sahod sa 5g kada oras. Inaasahan kong makita ang iyong résumé!^^-G. Morris, Tagapamahala^JojaMart ng Bayan ng Pelican

records.source: Tourist: Man... I can't take another bite of this barbecue sandwich... so stuffed.
records.translation: Turista: Pare... Hindi ko na kayang kumagat pa sa sandwich na barbecue na ito... busog na busog ako.

records.source: Are you strong like me? Smash stone!
records.translation: Malakas ka bang gaya ko? Basagin ang bato!

records.source: Tourist: Wow. That's the biggest cheese wheel I've ever seen. Very impressive.
records.translation: Turista: Wow. Iyan ang pinakamalaking bilog ng kesong nakita ko. Talagang kahanga-hanga.

records.source: Tourist: It was a long bus ride here, but totally worth it! This valley is so beautiful. Simon loves it... don't you, Simon?
records.translation: Turista: Mahaba ang biyahe rito sa bus, pero sulit na sulit! Napakaganda ng lambak na ito. Gustong-gusto ito ni Simon... hindi ba, Simon?

records.source: Tourist: It's a fine-looking town you've got here. Nice and cozy, and a real sense of community.
records.translation: Turista: Maganda ang bayan ninyo rito. Kaaya-aya at maginhawa, at dama talaga ang pagkakaisa ng komunidad.
